description: This file exports various type definitions, functions, and classes related to the context engine, including registration, retrieval, and legacy handling, primarily acting as an index or aggregation module.

methods.name: registerContextEngine
methods.description: Registers a new context engine by providing its implementation.

methods.name: getContextEngineFactory
methods.description: Retrieves the factory for creating context engine instances.

methods.name: listContextEngineIds
methods.description: Lists all registered context engine identifiers.

methods.name: resolveContextEngine
methods.description: Resolves and retrieves a specific context engine by ID.

methods.name: registerLegacyContextEngine
methods.description: Registers a legacy context engine implementation.

methods.name: delegateCompactionToRuntime
methods.description: Delegates the compaction process to the runtime.

methods.name: ensureContextEnginesInitialized
methods.description: Ensures that all context engines are initialized before use.
